preconditions.description: The number of nodes n must be between 2 and 10^5 inclusive.
Each of the n-1 lines must contain exactly four integers: u_i, v_i, x_i, c_i.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(u) <= n and 1 <= int(v) <= n for u, v, _, _ in (line.split() for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]))
preconditions.description: Each node u_i and v_i must be between 1 and n inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(x) <= 10**9 + 6 for _, _, x, _ in (line.split() for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]))
preconditions.description: Each clamminess value x_i must be between 1 and 10^9 + 6 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(c in ['0', '1'] for _, _, _, c in (line.split() for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]))
preconditions.description: Each thread color c_i must be either '0' (red) or '1' (black).

preconditions.expression: len(set((u, v) for u, v, _, _ in (line.split() for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:])) | set((v, u) for u, v, _, _ in (line.split() for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:])))) == n - 1
preconditions.description: The cobweb must be a tree (no cycles, connected, n-1 edges).

postconditions.description: The output must be a single integer.

postconditions.expression: int(stdout.strip()) == 1 or (all(0 <= abs(red_count - black_count) <= 2 for red_count, black_count in path_stats) and int(stdout.strip()) == product_of_products % (10**9 + 7))
postconditions.description: If there are no valid paths (where the difference between red and black threads is at most 2), the output must be 1. Otherwise, the output must be the product of the clamminess products of all valid paths, modulo 10^9 + 7. Here, path_stats is a list of (red_count, black_count) pairs for all valid paths, and product_of_products is the product of the clamminess products of these paths.
The output must be congruent to itself modulo 10^9 + 7.
